'''Darth Ramage''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was part of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|lineage]] of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].<ref name="The Last Jedi" />

==Biography==
During his lifetime, Ramage created a [[SD41263.I|Sith holocron]] that contained instructions relating to the combination of [[Bota/Legends|bota]] and [[pyronium]]. Ramage also performed experiments on the [[Cephalon]]s, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that could perceive past and future events through [[Time/Legends|time]], to explore the possibility of harnessing the power of [[Time travel/Legends|time travel]].<ref name="The Last Jedi" />
